epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful backend health check passes from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: The backend application must successfully start up and report healthy on port 18080 without database connection failures.

slices.title: Remediate backend startup failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to resolve the connection refused errors, so that the application startup remediation is achieved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the deployed backend and database containers
When the application starts and a request is made to /health on port 18080
Then the application successfully connects to the database and returns 200 OK
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
